fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/UsedTruck/BuyUsedTrucks.cy.js#UsedTruck - BuyUsedTrucks [en] — Buy Used Trucks TC-BUT-02: Contact Seller lead form shows required validation when submitted empty on Buy Used Trucks
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-BUT-02
**Title:** Contact Seller lead form shows required validation when submitted empty on Buy Used Trucks
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open the Buy Used Trucks page, open Contact Seller on a visible card, and submit with name, mobile and city all left empty.

**Expected Result:**
The real, page-shown validation messages for name, mobile and location are displayed, and no lead is submitted.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Buy Used Trucks page
2. Open the Contact Seller lead form from a visible card
3. Leave name, mobile and city empty and submit
4. Verify all three required-field validation messages are shown
